title: Concept: OS command execution via Process.Start (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, Process.Start executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (ProcessStartInfo with ArgumentList) are csharp-specific.
applicability: csharp codebases that launch external processes through Process.Start; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
